subject: Demogorgon
fact: Demogorgon roars and is advancing in the direction of Sloobludop.
source_quote: Demogorgon roars. And while Leemooggoogoon’s followers cheer in ecstasy, the followers of the Deep Sea Mother are either terrified, driven mad, or planning to stand their ground and fight the demon lord.

subject: Leemooggoogoon
fact: Leemooggoogoon is invoked as a being whose existence was brought into being by imagination.
source_quote: Shuushar, finally recovered from the sudden appearance of the demon lord, mutters, “Enlightmnet is necessary! We must change as a people. Our imagination brought into existence, Leemooggoogoon.”

subject: Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is a village of Kuotoans destroyed by Demogorgon, whose screams echo in the darkness.
source_quote: From a distance, they can see Demogorgon destroy the town of Sloobludop—the screams of the Kuotoans echo in the darkness.

subject: Darklake
fact: The Darklake is a body of water infested with demonic manta-ray creatures that rend flesh instead of filtering plankton.
source_quote: As he splutters, he notices that the Darklake isn’t empty. The same creatures that were feasting on the kuotoans are here. They look like manta rays, whose jaws, instead of being used to filter plankton, have powerful jaws for rending the flesh of their victims.

subject: Underdark
fact: The Underdark is a dangerous realm where demons do not simply appear but must be summoned with mighty magic.
source_quote: Daz reflects on his knowledge of the arcane and his time in the Underdark, “Demons do not just appear in the Underdark. They must be summoned. And the spell to summon a demon lord is some mighty magic.”

subject: Gracklstugh
fact: Gracklstugh is a destination known to Buppido, who claims to know people there.
source_quote: Buppido, who is no longer gagged, says, “Gracklstugh! I know people.”

subject: Velkynvelve
fact: Velkynvelve is a place where demons were seen, referenced by Grygum as evidence of demonic incursion.
source_quote: Grygum who says it out loud - “The spectator warned us about demons. And we saw the demons in Velkynvelve. Demons have made it to the prime material plane in large numbers!”

subject: Daz
fact: Daz collapses in tears and moans upon witnessing Demogorgon’s presence, later becomes a navigator who spots rocks and directs boat maneuvers.
source_quote: It's too much for Daz, who collapses in tears and moans. ... Standing on the front of the boat, Daz looks into the darkness. His eyes can see the water and the cave above him. ... He shouts, “Rocks! We need to dodge these rocks.” ... “On my say, heave port or starboard!” ... “Port!” ... “Starboard!” ... “Port! Starboard!”

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is short, notices ceiling height, falls into the Darklake, observes demonic manta-rays, and questions Eldeth’s disbelief about Demogorgon’s presence.
source_quote: Thorin reaches up and touches the cave's ceiling, which is only three feet above the water. ... “It’s good to be short,” Thorin notes ... he fell in, along with Grygum and Daz. ... As he climbs out of the water, he thinks it’s probably not good that a demonic fish is floating around with the local flora and fauna… ... Thorin stares at her, “I am not sure what you think is or is not possible, but I saw what I saw.”

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir muses on magical darkness, is annoyed by religious rituals, considers taking another boat, and observes Shuushar’s departure.
source_quote: “The ability to cast magical darkness and see through it opens up so many tactical opportunities,” he muses. ... The dragonborn is annoyed that he got caught up in a religious ritual that may or may not have summoned Demogorgon and is now floating through the Darklake in a tiny boat. ... Hemeth seems to be reading Zalthir’s mind when he suggests, “Maybe we take that boat from them? Like the last time I talked to Kuo-Toans, I almost got sacrificed. I was just trying to sell them weapons. I didn’t think they would think sacrificing me was a weapon. Crazy fish people.” ... Zalthir steps back and gets ready to attack, just in case. ... Zalthir stands off as he watches the tearful goodbye...

subject: Shuushar
fact: Shuushar is a Kuotoan who recovers from trauma, proclaims the necessity of enlightenment, guides the boat, and leaves the group to found a new Kuo-Toan society.
source_quote: Shuushar, finally recovered from the sudden appearance of the demon lord, mutters, “Enlightmnet is necessary! We must change as a people. Our imagination brought into existence, Leemooggoogoon.” ... As the boat floats on the lake, the puzzle pieces all click in Thorin’s head. ... Shuushar acts as a guide and navigator, pointing out where they can find water to drink and food to eat. ... “They are from Sloobludop and have seen the danger of the Kuo-Toan madness. And they are receptive to my message! They want to create a better Kuo-Toan world where we are no longer driven mad by our need to create a new god! I have found my calling! And I must leave you!” ... “I have found my people, and we will build a better world!”

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum advances boldly to the monitors, commands them with the Archpriest’s authority, carries Eldeth and Turvy, and voices the revelation about demons in Velkynvelve.
source_quote: Grygum advances boldly and tells them that the Archpriest of the Sea Mother commands them to help the rest of their community. ... Jimjar picks up Daz, Thorin grabs Eldeth, Topsy and Turvy are carried by Grygum, and Spiderbait carries Shuushar. ... Grygum who says it out loud - “The spectator warned us about demons. And we saw the demons in Velkynvelve. Demons have made it to the prime material plane in large numbers!”

subject: Eldeth
fact: Eldeth declares Demogorgon’s presence impossible, concurs on the danger to Faerûn, and warns of risks to dwarven miners.
source_quote: Eldeth mutters, “That was Demogorgon. He’s in the prime material plane. That is not possible.” ... Eldeth concurs, “The danger to all of Faerûn is undeniable. Even if we escape the Underdark, these demons won’t stay down here. And to think someone summoned demon lords! We need to get a warning to the surface worlds. Dwarven miners are at risk!”

subject: Spiderbait
fact: Spiderbait carries Shuushar, wails at the horror of the situation, and is referenced as a carrier of a Kuotoan.
source_quote: Spiderbait carries Shuushar. ... Spiderbait wails, “This is so not good. The Underdark isn’t a friendly place! And rampaging demons and demon lords!”

subject: Buppido
fact: Buppido is no longer gagged, knows people in Gracklstugh, and offers assistance after being reminded they have money.
source_quote: Buppido, who is no longer gagged, says, “Gracklstugh! I know people.” ... Buppido sighs, “Yes, and I know people who can help you.”

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar picks up Daz and asks Buppido if he wants to bet on his knowledge.
source_quote: Jimjar picks up Daz, Thorin grabs Eldeth, Topsy and Turvy are carried by Grygum, and Spiderbait carries Shuushar. ... Jimjar looks at him, “Wanna bet?”

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith mutters uncertainty about following Shuushar’s instructions after his departure.
source_quote: Sarith mutters a few moments later, “Erm, guys, I have Shuushar’s instructions, but I am not so sure I can follow them correctly.”

subject: Hemeth
fact: Hemeth suggests taking the other boat from the Kuotoans, recalling his near-sacrifice while selling weapons.
source_quote: Hemeth seems to be reading Zalthir’s mind when he suggests, “Maybe we take that boat from them? Like the last time I talked to Kuo-Toans, I almost got sacrificed. I was just trying to sell them weapons. I didn’t think they would think sacrificing me was a weapon. Crazy fish people.”

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin tells Shuushar to follow his bliss as he departs the group.
source_quote: Thorin says - “Follow your bliss!”

subject: Demonic manta-ray attack
fact: Four demonic manta-ray creatures attack Thorin, Grygum, and Daz in the Darklake but are defeated.
source_quote: As he splutters, he notices that the Darklake isn’t empty. The same creatures that were feasting on the kuotoans are here. They look like manta rays, whose jaws, instead of being used to filter plankton, have powerful jaws for rending the flesh of their victims. ... Fortunately for himself and his two companions, Daz and Grygum, there are only four. And unlike the Kuotoans, they are no match for them.

subject: Rocks in the cave passage
fact: Daz spots and directs the boat through a series of rocks in the cave, shouting port and starboard commands to avoid collision.
source_quote: He shouts, “Rocks! We need to dodge these rocks.” ... “On my say, heave port or starboard!” ... “Port!” ... “Starboard!” ... “Port! Starboard!”

subject: Shuushar’s departure
fact: Shuushar leaves the group to join other Kuotoans and found a new society free from madness and god-making.
source_quote: “They are from Sloobludop and have seen the danger of the Kuo-Toan madness. And they are receptive to my message! They want to create a better Kuo-Toan world where we are no longer driven mad by our need to create a new god! I have found my calling! And I must leave you!” ... “I have found my people, and we will build a better world!”

subject: Boat encounter with Kuotoans
fact: A second boat of Kuotoans is encountered; after communication, Shuushar departs with them.
source_quote: Just then, he hears a shout from the watch: “There’s another boat ahead with some Kuotoans.” ... The Awakened shouts out to his kinsmen. Shuushar is very excited; at least, it would appear to Zalthir, Shuushar’s excited. ... Finally, their Kuo-Toan companion turns to the group, “They are from Sloobludop and have seen the danger of the Kuo-Toan madness. And they are receptive to my message! They want to create a better Kuo-Toan world where we are no longer driven mad by our need to create a new god! I have found my calling! And I must leave you!”

subject: Demogorgon destroys Sloobludop

source_quote: From a distance, they can see Demogorgon destroy the town of Sloobludop—the screams of the Kuotoans echo in the darkness.

source_quote: Grygum advances boldly and tells them that the Archpriest of the Sea Mother commands them to help the rest of their community. ... The Monitors seem relieved to have a purpose and rush off.

subject: Boarding the boat and floating away

source_quote: And with that, they board the boat and float away, paddling quietly not to be heard.

source_quote: Eldeth mutters, “That was Demogorgon. He’s in the prime material plane. That is not possible.” ... Grygum who says it out loud - “Demons have made it to the prime material plane in large numbers!”

subject: Darklake
fact: The Darklake is a body of water filled with demonic manta-rays and haunted by the echoes of Sloobludop’s destruction.
source_quote: The dragonborn is annoyed that he got caught up in a religious ritual that may or may not have summoned Demogorgon and is now floating through the Darklake in a tiny boat. ... As he splutters, he notices that the Darklake isn’t empty. The same creatures that were feasting on the kuotoans are here. They look like manta rays, whose jaws, instead of being used to filter plankton, have powerful jaws for rending the flesh of their victims.

subject: lake
fact: The lake is where the group floats away quietly after escaping the destruction of Sloobludop.
source_quote: And with that, they board the boat and float away, paddling quietly not to be heard.

subject: cave ceiling
fact: The cave ceiling is three feet above the water, forcing occupants to crouch.
source_quote: Thorin reaches up and touches the cave's ceiling, which is only three feet above the water.

subject: Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is a village of Kuotoans destroyed by Demogorgon.
source_quote: From a distance, they can see Demogorgon destroy the town of Sloobludop—the screams of the Kuotoans echo in the darkness.

subject: Gracklstugh
fact: Gracklstugh is a destination where Buppido claims to know people who can provide equipment.
source_quote: Buppido, who is no longer gagged, says, “Gracklstugh! I know people.”

subject: Velkynvelve
fact: Velkynvelve is a place where demons were previously observed, referenced as proof of incursion.
source_quote: Grygum who says it out loud - “The spectator warned us about demons. And we saw the demons in Velkynvelve. Demons have made it to the prime material plane in large numbers!”

subject: Underdark
fact: The Underdark is a realm where demons must be summoned with mighty magic.
source_quote: Daz reflects on his knowledge of the arcane and his time in the Underdark, “Demons do not just appear in the Underdark. They must be summoned. And the spell to summon a demon lord is some mighty magic.”
